noneYet: No rehearsals on the agenda yet.
liveExplain: Nothing starts playing on its own: the metronome starts only when whoever conducts presses play. An admin or authorised member can take over conducting.
needsControl: Members allowed to run rehearsals open Live Rehearsal; you can join as soon as it is open.

board.title: Rehearsal board
board.empty: No comments yet. Agree on what to play, say if you are running late, note what is left for next time.
board.deleteConfirm: Remove this comment from the board?
board.afterEnd: The rehearsal is over, but the board stays open.

invites.title: Personal invitations
invites.explain: One private link per musician. It works once, expires and can be revoked. The person creates their own account (or uses the one they have) when opening it.
invites.name: Musician's name
invites.created: Invitation created. Copy the link now: for security it is shown only this once.

landing.title: Invitation for {{name}}
landing.notYou: This invitation is personal. If it is not for you, do not use it: ask the band's admin for yours.
landing.privacy: Use your own e-mail and a password only you know. Nobody in the band sees your password.
landing.invalid: This invitation link does not exist or was mistyped.
landing.used: This invitation was already used. If it was you, sign in with your account.
landing.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the band's admin for a new one.
landing.revoked: This invitation was revoked. Ask the band's admin for a new one.
landing.alreadyMember: You are already in this band.
